subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “In computer class, students searched their own names online.”?
options: Some found photos, game profiles, old comments, and school event pages.
Leo searched online and found the same story on many pages.
Archaeologists found writing scratched onto a wall in an old building.
Two days later, an old woman came to the school.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Some found photos, game profiles, old comments, and school event pages.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Leo searched online and found the same story on many pages.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Archaeologists found writing scratched onto a wall in an old building.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Two days later, an old woman came to the school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some found photos, game profiles, old comments, and school event pages.」，答案為「Some found photos, game profiles, old comments, and school event pages.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Some found photos, game profiles, old comments, and school event pages.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
